generic_domain.justification: Humanoid Robotics is the most comprehensive domain because it specifically refers to the development of robots with human-like features, including legged and bipedal capabilities. The other domains (bipedal robotics, bipedal robots, legged robotics) are subsets or specializations within Humanoid Robotics. This broader domain encompasses all forms of robots that mimic human structures and movements, making it the most generic choice.
